title: Avoid Git repository setup for launcher parser and transport fixtures
outcome: The 24 identified parser, timing and registration/wait cases use existing guarded scratch ownership while retaining every transcript, subprocess, timeout and assertion; genuinely source-sensitive cases keep real repositories.
acceptance: The 24 identified non-Git launcher fixture cases use guarded scratch directories and preserve every existing assertion, transcript, real subprocess, timeout and filesystem case check; source, lifecycle, drift, linked-worktree and stop/recovery integration still use real repositories

Original launcher output records before-and-after Node total/pass/skip/todo counts on comparable exact declared inputs, with no lost test or relaxed assertion, and records measured stage durations without claiming the parent's final Windows FULL target
